output.notes: The paper applies DyT to many architectures (ViT, ConvNeXt, DiT, wav2vec 2.0, HyenaDNA, Caduceus, LLaMA). I describe LLaMA with DyT because it is the decoder-only language model the IR targets. The paper gives only width and depth for each size. It writes the 34B/70B width as 8196, likely a typo for 8192; I kept it as written. The DyT alpha init for 7B is 0.8 in attention blocks and 0.2 elsewhere (13B: 0.6/0.15; 34B/70B: 0.2/0.05); non-LLM models use 0.5. Base LLaMA details (pre-norm, SwiGLU, RoPE, residual, exact attention) are marked inherited from LLaMA, but the paper cites LLaMA 1, 2 and 3 without choosing one. I left heads, kv_heads, d_ff, vocab, context length, rope theta and tying not_stated.
